sources.entry: Brk - Native Swift and AppKit rebuild of Arc on Chromium, with a Raycast-style command bar and AI that runs on your own Claude Code or Codex plan and local models. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/cyang2020/brk) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Brk is a native macOS Swift/AppKit web browser on Chromium that rebuilds Arc's interface feature by feature, with a Raycast-style command bar and AI features that run through your existing coding-agent plans or local models.
summary.what_it_does: Brk is a macOS web browser built on Chromium (BrkCore) that aims to reproduce Arc 1.170's interface, including the sidebar, Spaces, Favorites, pinned tabs, split view, Little Arc, Peek, Boosts, the Library and the command bar. The command bar handles calculations, unit and currency conversion, a local file index searchable by meaning, app launching, emoji, translation, colour codes, window placement, and searching within sites. An AI panel can read and act on open tabs, and scheduled pages can refresh themselves. The README says AI runs on the coding agent already signed in on the Mac, with small on-device models for tasks like tab naming. A setup flow imports bookmarks, history, passwords and Spaces from Arc, Chromium-based browsers, Safari and Firefox. Builds are distributed as signed DMGs for Apple silicon and Intel, and the README describes a Chromium patch series and test suites in the repository.
use_cases: replace Arc browser on a Mac
use a keyboard-driven command bar for browsing
chat with an AI about open tabs
search local files on a Mac by meaning
import bookmarks and history from another browser
run a browser with a sidebar and Spaces
build a browser from source on macOS
notable: Rebuilds Arc 1.170 from measurements of Arc's own app; README reports 0.14% pixel difference from Arc in a comparison screenshot
Command bar with Tab-activated modes and Chinese-language mode words
Uses the coding agent already signed in on the Mac (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode) rather than a Brk account
Imports directly from Arc, Chrome-family browsers, Safari and Firefox, and a second import adds only new items
Local file index and embeddings so semantic search stays on the Mac
caveats: Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later and, to build from source, Xcode with Swift 6 and a downloaded BrkCore framework
Many features are marked built but not verified, including tab groups, extensions pop-ups, site permissions, picture-in-picture and printing
Only 126 of 148 Arc features in the ledger are verified; some Arc features are deliberately left out (accounts, Dia sending, notes)
Safari import requires exporting data first, and Safari 17 and older need Full Disk Access; Chrome, Firefox and Arc passwords were not tested with real data
The README says Arc no longer gets new features, and the project is positioned as a continuation for Arc users
